A DELE task operationalizes an A1 performance; it does not independently assign Spanish words, grammar points or MWUs to A1.
Multiple choice, matching, timing and answer-sheet mechanics are exam design, not mandatory teaching methodology.
Model 0 validates task format only; its passages, prompts, images, audios and answers are not reusable SpanishStories content.
Repeated task text types may corroborate PCIC/CEFR genre coverage, but do not expand the genre inventory by themselves.
A text type appearing in reading/listening does not imply the learner must produce that genre at A1.
DELE input/output lengths are task specifications; they are not default length limits for SpanishStories stories.
The oral interaction profile preserves the A1 condition of a cooperative interlocutor.
DELE A1 para escolares preserves the A1 structure while adapting contexts to ages 11-17; it is a contextual variant, not a separate level.
